# RB-20 Monthly credit query

Scope: NabaLens internal. Back to the [index](README.md).

| Field                         | Content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Trigger                       | A person says their monthly count is wrong                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Operator role                 | OPS                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| First checks                  | Find the person's venue, month and target row (Needs setup means no target yet). Credit is computed when read from immutable history (private.monthly_venue_completion_counts); there is no stored count to inspect.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Steps                         | Explain with the documented rules (docs/usage-staff.md, What counts toward your monthly target): a photo counts once, after acceptance, when uploaded and sent at the venue in the same UK month; a photo deleted in its month stops counting; past months keep accepted totals; manager-added and attached photos count for the task only; after a move, past months stay with the old venue; a Couldn't establish answer gives no credit. If the rules give the count shown, close the query. If they do not, it is a defect: record it for WS1 with the venue, month and account kind. Counts are never edited; a past-month change waits for B08 corrections and the owner's decisions on credit. |
| Narrowest switch              | None: credit is derived, never switched                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Switches in the catalogue     | none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Data implications             | None: credit is never written by hand.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Pending delivery              | No consumer delivery is involved.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Readback that proves recovery | The count shown equals the documented rules applied to the person's history, or a defect is recorded.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

- None. The claims need a database; see the drill.
